resources.string: Lets the paired phone type into the text field that is selected on the TV, press Back or Home, and put the TV to sleep. It looks for the text field only when the phone types.
Connected to your phone remote relay
Live view for the phone remote
Scan with your phone\'s camera and open the link, then Add to Home Screen. It works from anywhere.
The code is hidden. Show it to pair another phone.

No relay address in this build.

Deploy relay/ to your Cloudflare account (npx wrangler deploy), then build with
./gradlew assembleRelease -PrelayUrl=https://tv-remote.<you>.workers.dev
and install again. The README has the steps.
New code. Phones paired before must scan it again.
From the phone at %1$s · press OK to close
Enter PIN to show the code
